note: *e o teu holocausto se torne gordo*: the Latinist's verb (*fíeri*, major). The stylist found *gordo* prosaic and asked *seja rico em gordura*, option 3; the blind reader did not know *holocausto*.
D33's headline: *e confirme todo o teu desígnio*. The blind reader heard *conselhos* as advice given to others; *desígnio* is for a purpose. *todo o teu conselho* is the option.

*agora soube*: the Latinist's major, after a minor on *agora sei*, which the translator had held (the perfect of a knowing-verb states knowledge). HANDOFF names it for your ear; *agora sei* is option 2.
*está em atos de poder*: the stylist's worst line was *em poderes*; the gate asked it back (minor), refused. *atos de poder* keeps the root and plural of the Greek δυναστεῖαι.
